prs.title: MAINT: Handle overflow in i0 for large inputs like 713.0
prs.body: Fix overflow in np.i0(713.0) — exp(x) overflow via log trick: exp(x + log(val) - 0.5*log(x)) in _lib/_function_base_impl.py. Solves issue #32209 where i0 returned inf. First-time NumPy contribution — numerical stability fix.
